results: A retained genuine polynomial automorphism has the dense three-good profile, selected intrinsic kernel S=C[h,k], and selected speed k. The primitive clearing G=(V+hU)^2-kV+h^3 specializes at (h) to V(V-k), two disjoint lines.
Canonical Taylor differentiation independently gives Phi=-kG/h^4. Thus this is a failure for the actual primitive first-tail model, not an unrelated generic coordinate or a failure of145.

The full invariant ring A_k=S_k[y,z,w0]=S_k[a] remains polynomial. Two exact source relations remove the unwanted projected component. The open immersion and Laurent escaping-parameter formulas describe precisely this example, not all actual charts.

A different actual family has an everywhere-coordinate curve equation but a nonpolynomial canonical normalized parameter. Dividing the common factor of its leading derivation repairs its normalization; the canonical factor is not automatically a unit.
Primary source comparison identifies full-gradient, all-primes, same-base retraction and residue-constant hypotheses. None is supplied just by generic primitivity.
